strings.support_methods_subtitle: Suɓo feere darnde ɓurnde welde. Kala dokkal ngal ina yoɓa ƴettugol, jaɓɓaade, e jarribaade kaɓirɗe.
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis regularly rolls out newer firmwares for players like the Y1 (targeting hidden board revisions like 6.0, 7.0, and 8.0) that silently break older devices. Worse, their website provides zero warnings and zero access to previous working firmwares to recover from a bricked state. Hesɗitinoowo and the Community Firmware project pick up the pieces: we archive every legacy stock ROM, automatically verify your hardware revision, and keep your player running safely.
strings.support_story_1_headline: So peewnoowo yahrii yeeso, renndo ngoo ina ƴellitoo.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Hisnude Fulɓe bonɓe: Ƴeewte kisal ina ɗaɓɓi kesɗitingol kesol ngol meeɗaa haɗde hardware ɓooyɗo.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROMs Stock archived: Koolol timmungol firmwares asliiji usineeji Innioasis momtaa.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Koolaaɗo kuuɓal: Kuutorɗe ɓuuɓɗe timmuɗe ngam macOS, Linux, e Windows fof.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hakkille Hardware : Yiytude alluwal otomatik ngam heɓde sahaa kala paaspoor potɗo.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Reende kaɓirgol maa e jolɗe hardware deƴƴuɗe e waylooji bonɗi.
strings.support_story_2_body: Rewindaade lowre Innioasis laawɗunde ina heewi firtude ko ƴeewde jokkorɗe Google Drive timmuɗe, jokkondire ruulde Baidu maayɗe, e piille zip sirlu ɗe ngalaa kuutorɗe ɓuuɓɗe. Min mahii lowre ƴettugol koolkisaande, nde alaa ko woni e mum so wonaa laaɓal SHA-256 hoolkisaangal, humpitooji kesɗitingol, e jolngooji gonɗi e doggol. Dokke mon ina njokki e ƴellitde ƴeewndorɗe e hosting baawɗo waɗde ɗum waktuuji 24 e ñalawma, balɗe 365 e hitaande.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Alaa Diskooji Google bonɗi. Alaa teskaade-golle. Firmware golloowo tan.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: CDN Direct High-Speed ​​: Jaawɗo, ƴettugol toowngol tawa alaa keerol ƴettugol walla jokkorɗe maayɗe.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Hesɗitin Notifications: Heɓ jeertinaango e sahaa nde renndo keso yaltini walla peewnugol ngol yani.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Installs Guided Ɗatal-Ɗatal: Ɗaɓɓaaɗe yiyteede laaɓtuɗe ina njahda e kala toɓɓugol butoŋ.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Renndo ɗemɗe keewɗe: Engele, Sinuwaa, Almaañ, Españool, Farayse & Japon.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Jaawgol, hoolkisaangol renndo ngo mbaaw-ɗaa fawaade e mum tigi.
strings.support_story_3_body: Software Stock factory ina ƴakka tan ko lowre maa Y1 walla Y2 waawi waɗde. Renndo men addii Rockbox, njuɓɓudi gollordu keeriindi leefndi, ƴeewndo kodek audiophile, e tiitooɗe kuutorteeɗe e nguurndam. Min cooda mbayliigaaji hardware ɓalliwal e nder poos ngam ƴeewndaade, waylude innde, e hoolkisaade kala install. Wallude Hesɗitinoowo ina yoɓa ɗeen kuutorɗe jarribooje e yaawnaade ƴellitgol firmware keeriiɗo.
